cc:Work.dc:description: Unsmoothed CSV percentages. Stars use the highest overall AP (BASE round 306, FULL round 300) in both panels. Circles mark round 320. Shading covers integer rounds 297–320. Source CSV SHA-256: 69363935b0163a7f5ed7b3bcf3caff3812c337badc1ec4f6f0d48607873b6931.
